name: See You Next Twilight
source:
You’re fresh off the train tumbling into Sunshine’s Peak in search of a new life, hoping to write a better story for yourself this time. While the town welcomes you with open arms, something sinister lurks beneath the horizon, nipping at your heels where the sun's rays can’t reach…

’Round these parts, the sun rarely sets…and when it does, nobody can stop what comes next.

[From [url=https://ghostlusterstudios.itch.io/see-you-next-twilight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚下火车，跌跌撞撞地驶入阳光峰，寻找新的生活，希望这一次为自己写出更好的故事。当小镇张开双臂欢迎你时，地平线下却潜伏着某种邪恶的东西，在阳光无法到达的地方咬住你的脚后跟……

“在这些地方，太阳很少落山……当太阳落山时，没有人可以阻止接下来发生的事情。”

[来自[url=https://ghostlusterstudios.itch.io/see-you-next-twilight]itch.io[/url]]
